env.service: UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8799 --data $SCR/service-data --browser-origin http://localhost:5190 (a fresh empty dir)
env.page: bunx vite --config docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p4-mobile-proof/vite.e2e.config.mts (the repo's browser config with no watcher and no HMR; http://localhost:5190, the dev CSP that allows loopback)
env.world: bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json scripts/seed-shared-world.ts make --service ws://127.0.0.1:8799 --out $SCR/seed (aether-land 1.3.0 packed, uploaded and announced) → __INVITE__; … invite --out $SCR/seed → __INVITE_B__
env.desktop: app B: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/ud-b bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9347, a fresh userData whose inference.json names an unreachable loopback llama.cpp (http://127.0.0.1:8098/v1, no sidecar) so nothing can call a model
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9342 (phone) or 9347 (desktop B) bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(sed 's|__INVITE_B__|<B link>|; s|__INVITE__|<phone link>|; s|__SHOTS__|<dir>|g; s|/__REPO__|<absolute repo path>|g' <run file>)" — '/@fs/<absolute path>' is the exact URL the page imports these modules by, so the probes read the page's own module instances (a '//' path would load fresh copies)
env.viewport: phone: 375 × 812, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile with touch emulation (each phone run starts with {viewport})
env.input: phone: touch only (tap, tapText, drags held on the docked stick) and text typed into the focused field; evals only read (samplePlayer, the land/session stores, remoteRoster, IndexedDB, window.seed.world.read/badges). Desktop B: clicks, typed text, the N key, one select() of its name field.

part: P2-C — presence: the phone walks back toward desktop B's player and each draws the other

actions.eval: (async () => { const r = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/engine/remoteRoster.ts'); return JSON.stringify(r.sampleRemotePlayers(performance.now()).map((p) => ({name: p.name, x: +p.x.toFixed(2), z: +p.z.toFixed(2), facing: p.facing}))); })()

(async () => { const m = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/engine/playerProbe.ts'); const p = m.samplePlayer(); return JSON.stringify(p && {sceneId: p.sceneId, x: +p.x.toFixed(3), z: +p.z.toFixed(3), yaw: +p.yaw.toFixed(3)}); })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const m = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/engine/playerProbe.ts'); const r = await import('/@fs/__REPO__/src/renderer/engine/remoteRoster.ts'); const p = m.samplePlayer(); const o = r.sampleRemotePlayers(performance.now())[0]; return !!p && !!o && Math.abs(p.x - o.x) < 2.5; })()
